title: It’s been 8 months, and it’s fallen apart
text: It’s been 8 months, and it’s fallen apart. I have had this table since March. It is November and one of the legs completely detached from the glass….

features: Table 8mm tempered clear glass, with black powder coated metal leg and four glass metal suckers on four corners of table.
Unites all sorts of house furniture with graceful elegance allowing your dining room to be decorated with modernistic looks and feels.
Beautiful blend of comfort and ease.

description: Safety is also not a concern for our dining table, since the tempered glasses are knowing for their wide safety margin to the point that normal glasses dim in comparison owing to the former not breaking into sharp splints rather into small spherical/circular pieces when subject to considerable force/pressure.
